posts.title: Generative AI drives the value of consensus content to zero
posts.description: If your content strategy relies on hitting a high score in an SEO grading tool, generative AI is going to make your work obsolete. You need to switch to information gain.

posts.title: You waste budget when you optimize for checklists and folk wisdom
posts.description: If you optimize your website by clearing software warnings or copying what other people do, you are wasting your time and budget. You only get results when you understand what the system itself is trying to achieve.

posts.title: ChatGPT Decides Which Brands to Recommend Before It Runs a Search
posts.description: If your AI search plan relies on getting your page found when ChatGPT goes looking, you are optimizing the wrong part of the process. The model already has a brand shortlist before it runs a search.
